title: Connes' trace theorem and the log-polyhomogeneous calculus for Carnot manifolds
summary: The Wodzicki residue is the unique trace on the algebra of classical pseudodifferential operators on a closed manifold, and Connes in 1988 proved that it coincides with the Dixmier trace. There are also ``higher" residues, defined on the set of operators whose symbols that can be expressed as polynomials of a logarithm, introduced by Lesch, and these are related to other singular traces.
